boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Muhlenberg rituals and recurring campus events, from Welcome Weekend through Senior Days.

cards.title: Pass the Flame at Orientation
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend · Haas College Center lawn
cards.notes: Join the Welcome Weekend gathering outside Haas, where the president, alumni, and first-year students pass candlelight across the lawn.
cards.short_summary: A candlelit welcome that starts the Muhlenberg experience.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg says Orientation candle-lighting gathers students outside Haas College Center; the president lights the first candle and the flame is passed to first-year students.
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of Orientation/Welcome Weekend; confirm the current program with the College.

cards.title: Receive a Red-and-Gray Scarf
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend · first-year and transfer welcome
cards.notes: Look for the post–candle-lighting scarf presentation, when alumni welcome new and transfer students into the Muhlenberg community.
cards.short_summary: A Welcome Weekend scarf ceremony for new Mules.
cards.evidence_claim: The College describes scarving as a newer tradition following Welcome Weekend candle-lighting, with alumni presenting red and gray scarves to first-year and transfer students.
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Welcome Weekend; intended for new and transfer students.

cards.title: Reconnect at the Welcome Back Picnic
cards.subtitle: Burkholder Quad · before classes begin
cards.notes: Head to Burkholder Quad on the evening before classes for the annual gathering that reconnects returning students, faculty, and staff.
cards.short_summary: A pre-semester quad gathering that welcomes the campus back.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies the Welcome Back Picnic as a gathering on Burkholder Quad held the evening before classes begin.
cards.access_notes: Held the evening before classes begin; check Welcome Weekend communications for timing.

cards.title: Hear Six Groups at A Cappella Fest
cards.subtitle: April · campus vocal performance tradition
cards.notes: Attend the April showcase to hear Muhlenberg’s a cappella groups together, with invited groups from other colleges and universities.
cards.short_summary: An annual vocal showcase that brings Muhlenberg’s ensembles together.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says A Cappella Fest is held each April and features Muhlenberg’s six a cappella groups plus special guests from other institutions.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in April; ticket proceeds support a local nonprofit, so verify current ticketing details.

cards.title: Watch Greek Sing Close Out Greek Week
cards.subtitle: Spring · Seegers Union Event Space
cards.notes: Catch the spring finale in Seegers, where Greek-letter chapters present dance and lip-synch performances after a week of activities.
cards.short_summary: A spring competition week ending in a performance night.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg says Greek Week includes activities and philanthropy, culminating in Greek Sing at the Seegers Union Event Space with dance/lip-synching performances.
cards.access_notes: Spring event; participation is connected to Greek-letter organizations, while performance attendance details should be confirmed locally.

cards.title: Cheer On Jefferson Field Day
cards.subtitle: May · campus fields and Life Sports Center
cards.notes: Look for the final-Friday-of-spring-semester event, when Jefferson Elementary students use Muhlenberg’s fields and Life Sports Center for games.
cards.short_summary: A yearly campus field day with Jefferson Elementary School.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says Jefferson Field Day occurs each May on the last Friday of the spring semester before finals and includes races, obstacle courses, and games.
cards.access_notes: A community-engagement event involving Jefferson Elementary students; participation roles are coordinated by the College.

cards.title: Take a Finals Break for Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Wood Dining Commons · finals week
cards.notes: During finals week, stop by Wood Dining Commons for the faculty, staff, and alumni-hosted breakfast served late in the evening.
cards.short_summary: A free finals-week breakfast served from 10 p.m. to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg states that faculty, staff, and alumni host a free late-night breakfast for students at Wood Dining Commons from 10 p.m. to midnight during finals week.
cards.access_notes: Directly documented as 10 p.m.–midnight during finals week; confirm the current finals-week schedule.

cards.title: Return for the Senior Candle-lighting
cards.subtitle: Senior Days · before Commencement weekend
cards.notes: Graduating students gather during Senior Days to pass candlelight once again, revisiting the ritual that opened their time at Muhlenberg.
cards.short_summary: The candle tradition returns as a four-year bookend.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg says its Senior Days candle-lighting echoes Orientation, with graduating students passing light to adjacent peers before Commencement weekend.
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Senior Days preceding Commencement weekend and is for graduating students.

cards.title: Climb the Miller Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Senior Days · Haas College Center
cards.notes: Eligible graduating students can take the guided Senior Days tour of the David A. Miller Bell Tower atop Haas College Center.
cards.short_summary: A guided tower visit offered through the senior class giving campaign.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says students who meet the Senior Class Connections Campaign gift challenge receive a guided Senior Days tour of the David A. Miller Bell Tower atop Haas College Center.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires meeting the current Senior Class Connections Campaign gift challenge; senior-only program.

cards.title: Mark National Mule Day
cards.subtitle: October 26 · Muhlenberg Activities Council programming
cards.notes: Check MAC’s October 26 program for the annual Mule-themed activities, which have included crafts, mocktails, photos, cookies, and giveaways.
cards.short_summary: An annual October 26 celebration centered on the Mule.
cards.evidence_claim: Muhlenberg identifies National Mule Day as an annual October 26 holiday programmed by the Muhlenberg Activities Council.
cards.access_notes: Annual date is October 26; activities vary by year, so consult MAC’s current announcement.
